Made by hand, made with heart

The beauty is
in the little things.

At SUGA, we believe a candle can be more than a lovely fragrance. It can be a pause between busy hours, a familiar feeling at the end of the day, or a gentle way of coming home to yourself.

Our intention is simple: create beautiful scents that make everyday rituals feel a little more special. Each candle is designed with care, from the fragrance blend to the final finishing touches.

OUR WAX

Our scented candles are made from 100% Natura Soy Wax.

OUR WICKS

We use eco candle wicks to provide rigidity, self-trimming properties, and a clean burn without lead, zind or metal cores. .

OUR PROCESS

Every material is carefully chosen. From the vessel to the fragrance oil. Each scented candle are hand-poured and made with utmost care and love.

With warmth, SUGA.

A little love goes a long way

Make every
burn beautiful.

A few thoughtful habits help you get the best experience from your candle, from the first light to the final glow.

MORE LITTLE RITUALS ↗

On the first burn, allow the wax to melt evenly across the surface before extinguishing, following the maximum burn time specified on your candle label. This helps reduce tunneling and uneven wax buildup.

Once the candle is completely cool, trim the cotton wick to about 1/4 inch. This allows a cleaner burn and maximum scent throw every time you light your candle. Remove loose wick debris before lighting.

Place your candle on a stable, heat-resistant surface away from drafts, curtains, children, and pets. Never leave a burning candle unattended or move it while the wax is liquid.

Our candles are designed to last for 3 to 4 hours maximum. Stop using it when the remaining wax reaches the about 1/8th of the jar, and let the vessel cool before handling or cleaning it.

Use an appropriate candle snuffer. Avoid blowing hot wax around. Ensure the flame is fully extinguished before leaving the room.
